title: StartingShapeRegistry
description: Avatar starting shapes offered at onboarding (planning/07 §3.1; owner decision 2026-10-13). Every shape is tied to the one base mesh named here. A starting shape is independent of presentation: any presentation goes with any shape (REQ-ONB-050). Ids are stable: never rename or reuse one. packages/shared-kernel/tests also check what a schema cannot express: default is one of the shape ids.

baseMesh.description: Base mesh id every shape starts from (doc 07 §3.1, §3.2)

default.description: The shape id preselected when the person makes no choice

shapes.description: Starting shape id (snake_case, the wire value) to its definition, in display order

description.description: What the shape is, for engineers; never user-facing copy
